scientific_limitations: The Gaussian theorem assumes fixed integer stage duration q>=2; only the finite identities and concentration are valid without that asymptotic restriction.
Uniform complete-graph transitions include self loops; noncomplete or nonuniform graph models are not covered.
The one-round Eulerian/subexcedant correspondence predates this result and is not a novelty claim.
No explicit Berry--Esseen error rate or independent historical-priority certification is established.
title: Sharp Gaussian deficit fluctuations for fixed-round walks on growing complete graphs
